```python
def adapt(parameters, policy, subsystem):
    """Apply pre-generation screening heuristics without mutating inputs."""
    result = dict(parameters)
    if subsystem == "structural":
        minimum = max(3.0, policy.get("minimum_mount_thickness_mm", 3.0))
        result["thickness_mm"] = max(minimum, result["thickness_mm"])
    elif subsystem == "aerodynamic":
        minimum = max(2.0, policy.get("minimum_hinge_gap_mm", 2.0))
        result["hinge_gap_mm"] = max(minimum, result["hinge_gap_mm"])
    return result
```
